activation.note: Activation covers mutually selected alternatives, modifications to existing alternatives and the source's runtime-dispatch boundary. Keywords are explicitly insufficient triggers; artifact and task facts are observable, change detection requires a new observer, and semantic applicability is honestly labeled llm_judged. The single-train exclusion matches the source scope.

audit.summary: All 22 segments survive at their claimed destinations, including mandatory branch declarations, acceptance conditions, test coverage and runtime limitations. The rewrite has one selection obligation in then, no shared-node moves, no undeclared additions and no added waivers.

segmentChecks.note: The then field retains deterministic guard-and-priority selection among declared linear train variants without changing the obligation.
Prefer[0] requires a shortcut to be declared as its own route, and avoid[0] prohibits undeclared bypasses.
Prefer[2] and avoid[4] preserve the mandatory per-branch guard, train, and accepted-artifact declarations; the split suggestion does not remove them.
Avoid[1] and avoid[2] retain both invalid cases and their new-acceptance condition without adding a waiver.
Prefer[1] preserves all five required evidence areas: matching, nonmatching, ambiguity/priority, errors, and contract preservation.
Avoid[3] and why expressly prohibit inferring unimplemented orchestration behavior from the pattern.

risks: The convention does not provide repository-specific syntax for declaring guards, routes, trains, priorities, or accepted artifacts, so implementation still requires the applicable project schemas; this is contextual rather than a missing source rule.

unobservable: finding: whether the work involves mutually selected alternatives is explicitly llm_judged and is not a Datalog-observable fact.
change: added or changed routes, guards, priorities, or train variants requires a new plan/source-diff observer before a Datalog engine can observe it.

review.summary: The sampled substantive segments are preserved at their claimed destinations, including the branch requirements, acceptance conditions, test coverage, and runtime boundary. A weak planning agent receives a clear decision procedure, although semantic applicability and change detection are not currently Datalog-deterministic; these limits are disclosed rather than concealed, so the auditor's PASS is justified.
